description: The two Table 5 values of Geva et al. 2022 that this package replicates: the share of toxic continuations (the Toxicity column) for GPT2 and for 10 Manual Pick, on the challenging subset of RealToxicityPrompts. Each record names its Table 5 row, the workflow step that runs that row, the percentage as the table prints it and its value as a fraction. table5_figure.py draws the page's Original from these records.
rule: value = the number of the printed percentage / 100. The table prints each rate to 0.1 percent, so a value is exact to 0.0005.
